[Using null as an array offset is deprecated, use an empty string instead](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/using-null-as-an-array-offset-is-deprecated,-use-an-empty-string-instead.html): Avoid using null as an array index.
[Using null as the key parameter for array_key_exists() is deprecated, use an empty string instead](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/using-null-as-the-key-parameter-for-array_key_existsqr-is-deprecated,-use-an-empty-string-instead.html): ``null`` cannot be used as an array index anymore, since PHP 8.

[Value of type %s is not callable](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/value-of-type-ps-is-not-callable.html): There was an attempt to call a function whose name was provided in a variable, but that value could not be related to a callable code.

[Visibility of property %s::$%s must not be weaker than set visibility](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/visibility-of-property-ps::$ps-must-not-be-weaker-than-set-visibility.html): When using asymmetric visibility, it is not allowed to have a weaker ``public`` visibility for writing than for reading (private).
[Void can only be used as a standalone type](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/void-can-only-be-used-as-a-standalone-type.html): ``void`` is a special return type, indicating that a function or method returns no useful value.
[void cannot be used as a parameter type](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/void-cannot-be-used-as-a-parameter-type.html): Void is a type, that can only be used with return type, on methods or functions.
[Write of ``%zu`` bytes failed with errno=%d %s](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/write-of-pzu-bytes-failed-with-errno=pd-ps.html): The ``errno=22`` happens when the path is an invalid path.
[Wrong encoding, conversion from "%s" to "%s" is not allowed](https://php-errors.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messages/wrong-encoding,-conversion-from-"ps"-to-"ps"-is-not-allowed.html): This message reports that the origin or the destination encoding when calling ``iconv()`` is not supported on this server.
